_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Look, Teacher — what large stones, what buildings!
Not one stone will be left upon another.
When you hear of wars and rumors, do not be alarmed.
This is but the beginning of the birth pangs.
Those who sleep in the dust will wake;
the wise will shine like the stars forever.
Come, let us worship and not lose heart.
The day is drawing near. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: The disciples marveled at the temple stones, and Jesus said, Do you see these great buildings? Not one stone will be left upon another.
The day is drawing near.
When the earth shakes and the nations rage, do not be alarmed; this is the beginning, the first birth pangs of something being born.
The day is drawing near.
Those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, and the wise will shine like the brightness of the sky, like the stars forever and ever.
The day is drawing near.
So let us hold fast to our hope without wavering, and spur one another on to love. Come, let us worship.
The day is drawing near. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Not one stone will be left standing on another.
We will not lose heart.
When the nations rage, do not be alarmed.
We will not lose heart.
The wise will shine like the stars forever.
We will not lose heart.
Come, hold fast and worship; the day draws near.
We will not lose heart. Amen.
